_about: English text the server sends (errors, activity log, notifications, emails) with its Bangla. 'exact' is matched whole; each 'patterns' entry is [english, bangla] where {x} matches any text, {x:map} also translates the value through maps[map], and {x:digits} turns 0-9 into Bangla digits. 'calendarPatterns' only apply to calendar items. Used by client/src/i18n/serverText.js and server/lib/i18n.js.
